## Goal
- Execute the owner's 100-module Instagram-level media QA mandate: audit, repair, develop, test, deploy, and verify MODULE-001 through MODULE-100 across the IVX Expo React Native app and public landing page, covering video, images, reels, carousels, uploads, downloads, caching, engagement, chat media, and enterprise QA with Instagram-style engineering techniques.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — this is the existing live IVX production project (plan_md confirms 40+ completed milestones); the `<new_project>` system tag is incorrect for this state
- Every module must have one result: PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / N/A — no PASS without live evidence
- No fake data, simulated uploads, or placeholder success — every media URL must come from real production database/storage
- Preserve existing members, investors, buyers, properties, deals, reels, posts, messages, documents, and transactions
- Deploy only through TEAM-12 Release Manager; production deployment requires owner approval
- Autonomous defect repair loop: create defect ID → reproduce → root cause → fix → typecheck → unit/integration/E2E tests → media regression → build → deploy → verify → retest → proof ledger
- Do not stop after identifying problems — repair every issue with current access
- Do not claim Instagram-level performance without measured results
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Phrase-gated actions: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_OWNER_SUPABASE_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_PRODUCTION_APPROVAL, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`

## Progress
### Done
- PRIOR MANDATE (Real-Data Recovery) — FULLY COMPLETED AND DEPLOYED:
  - 6 new service/API files + hono.ts route wiring committed and deployed live
  - Runtime commit `5a901952cb50`, boot 2026-07-18T19:31:29Z, Render deploy dep-d9dt7cd5tq5c738i8q30 LIVE
  - 3-way SHA parity: GitHub = Render Runtime = `5a901952cb50` (match=True)
  - 7/7 health endpoints 200, tsc 0 errors, 104/104 tests pass (333 expects)
  - 5 real-data routes verified live (separation, financial-ledger, outreach-guardrails, architecture-map, investor-audit)
  - Real data: Capital Sought=$4,925,000 (3 deals), Committed=$0, Funds Received=$0, 1119 prospects, 1041 awaiting outreach approval
  - 17-section final evidence report emitted and plan file updated
- CURRENT MANDATE (100-Module Media QA) — AUDIT IN PROGRESS:
  - ~25 core media files audited across lib/, components/, hooks/, app/
  - Baseline tsc: 0 errors (clean)
  - Baseline tests: 45/45 media-related tests pass (canonical-reel-card, ivx-media-jobs, ivx-multimodal-upload, chat-persistence-verify — 127 expects)
  - Live evidence gathered:
    - Video feed: GET /api/ivx/video-platform/feed → HTTP 200, 7 videos, all `published`, all with poster_url + hls_url
    - Home feed: GET /api/ivx/video-platform/home-feed → HTTP 200, pattern `3-deals-1-featured-project-video`, 4 blocks, ordering `canonical-home-v3`
    - Video download: GET /api/ivx/videos/:id/download → HTTP 206 (Range-enabled partial content)
    - Engagement save: POST /api/projects/:id/save → HTTP 200, save_count=2
    - Video events: POST /api/ivx/video-platform/events → HTTP 200, recorded=1
    - Follow: POST /api/ivx/video-platform/follow → HTTP 200, following=true, follower_count=2
    - Stories: GET /api/ivx/video-platform/stories → HTTP 200
    - Live: GET /api/ivx/video-platform/live → HTTP 200
    - Landing: GET https://ivxholding.com/ → HTTP 200, 452,284B
    - Landing reels.js: GET https://ivxholding.com/ivx-reels.js → HTTP 200, 56,108B
    - APK: HEAD https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.8.apk → HTTP 200, 84,462,560B
    - AAB: HEAD https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.8.aab → HTTP 200, 42,594,120B
    - 7/7 health endpoints 200 (/health, /health/live, /health/ready, /health/ai, /health/database, /health/queue, /health/provider)
  - Landing reels JS audited for white banner/disappearing reels — no white banner found (#ivxReels background is #000, card overlays use dark gradients, no white background issues)
  - DEFECT-001 FOUND AND FIXED: `expo/hooks/useReelsFeed.ts` loadMore was broken — re-fetched from offset 0 with `PAGE_SIZE * 3` instead of paginating. Fixed to use proper offset-based pagination with `fetchVideoFeed(PAGE_SIZE, currentOffset)` and offsetRef tracking. tsc clean after fix, 45/45 media tests still pass.

### In Progress
- Continuing MODULE-001 through MODULE-100 audit — currently around MODULE-001/002 (core media architecture map + dependencies audit)
- Need to systematically evaluate all 100 modules, produce per-module evidence, and compile final 30-section report
- Need to identify and fix additional defects beyond DEFECT-001

### Blocked
- iOS TestFlight: Apple credentials not provided
- Google Play AAB upload signing: credentials not provided
- Physical device QA: owner-device testing required (camera, gallery, downloads, storage permissions, background/foreground, weak network, app restart)
- supabase_execute_sql blocked: SUPABASE_DB_URL/DATABASE_URL/POSTGRES_URL absent from local runtime
- Project media endpoint GET /api/projects/:id returned 404 for video UUID (may need project UUID not video UUID — needs investigation)
- Investor audit endpoint returns truncated response for full 1000+ records (serialization size guard)

## Key Decisions
- Fixed DEFECT-001 in useReelsFeed.ts: replaced broken `fetchFeedPage(PAGE_SIZE * 3)` re-fetch with proper offset-based pagination using `offsetRef` and `fetchVideoFeed(PAGE_SIZE, currentOffset)` — hook was dead code (videos.tsx implements own pagination inline) but mandate requires repairing every issue
- Built financial ledger as independent store from CRM scoring — only reconciled escrow/bank counts as funds
- Investor classification quarantines TEST+INVALID via `isProductionVisible()` — single filter every dashboard must call
- Outreach guardrails are hard blocks (409 + reason) not soft warnings
- 7-category separation replaces single "Investor Pipeline" number
- GitHub commit via developer-deploy/action API requires nested `input` object: `{action, confirm:true, confirmText, input:{branch, path, content, contentEncoding:"base64", message}}`
- Render deploys commit-by-commit; `render_restart_service` requires phrase `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE`

## Next Steps
1. Continue systematic audit of MODULE-001 through MODULE-100 — read remaining media files, probe remaining live endpoints, record per-module evidence
2. Identify and fix additional defects (autonomous repair loop per mandate)
3. After all fixes: run full regression (tsc + all tests + media regression)
4. Deploy through TEAM-12 with owner approval (rollback tag, backup, full pre-deploy checks)
5. Verify 3-way SHA parity after deploy (GitHub HEAD = Render SHA = /health runtime SHA)
6. Execute 20-step live production acceptance test (upload picture, carousel, video, publish reel, play, like, comment, save, share, download, close/reopen, verify associations)
7. Compile final 30-section report (modules passed/failed/blocked, defects, architecture map, Instagram technique table, Android/Web/iOS QA tables, performance results, security results, files changed, commit SHA, rollback tag, Render deploy ID, health results, APK/AAB, proof ledger IDs, owner-only blockers, honest certification)

## Critical Context
- Live prod: https://api.ivxholding.com (healthy, commit `5a901952cb50`, boot 2026-07-18T19:31:29Z)
- 3-way SHA parity: GitHub `5a901952cb50` = Runtime `5a901952cb50` (match=True)
- APK: https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.8.apk (84,462,560 B, HTTP 200)
- AAB: https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.8.aab (42,594,120 B, HTTP 200)
- Video feed has 7 published videos, all with poster_url + hls_url — Instagram-style architecture already mature
- Home feed pattern: `3-deals-1-featured-project-video` (3 investment cards + 1 reel, canonical-home-v3 ordering)
- Landing reels JS (ivx-reels.js) is 56KB, handles full-screen snap feed, infinite scroll, autoplay/pause, HLS, double-tap like, comments, share, save, follow, stories, live row, audience channels, personalized ranking, upload with progress, creator dashboard, report
- Codebase already implements many Instagram-style techniques: viewability-based playback (80% threshold), one active reel player, max 3 mounted (active ± 1), poster-first rendering, expo-av crash avoidance on Android (HLS→MP4 fallback, disabled posterSource), per-reel error boundary, AppState foreground/background pause, network disconnect pause, cursor pagination, offline upload queue, retry with exponential backoff, optimistic engagement with rollback, thumbnail-first progressive loading, memory cache with LRU eviction, image prefetch batching
- Provider: PROVIDER_READY, vercel_ai_gateway, openai/gpt-4o
- Watchman stubbed at /usr/local/bin/watchman (original at /usr/local/bin/watchman.real)
- `bun x tsc --noEmit` is the correct typecheck command (npx not allowed)

## Relevant Files
- expo/hooks/useReelsFeed.ts: MODIFIED (DEFECT-001 fix) — broken loadMore replaced with proper offset-based pagination using offsetRef + fetchVideoFeed(PAGE_SIZE, currentOffset)
- expo/components/ReelVideoPlayer.tsx: Instagram-style video player — poster-first, max 3 mounted, shouldPlay lifecycle, Android HLS→MP4 fallback, network disconnect pause, error boundary isolation
- expo/components/SafeVideo.tsx: Defensive expo-av wrapper — disables poster on Android, HLS→MP4 fallback, retry on load error, surfaces errors instead of crashing
- expo/components/CanonicalInvestmentReelCard.tsx: ONE shared reel card for Main/Reels/Landing — full-bleed media, badges, metrics, right-side action rail (like/comment/save/share/audio), CTAs
- expo/hooks/useReelPlayback.ts: Active reel index + screen focus + playback condition (shouldPlay = isScreenFocused && isAppForeground && isItemActive), 80% viewability threshold, shouldMount limits to active ± 1
- expo/hooks/useReelEngagement.ts: Likes/comments/shares/saves/views with optimistic updates and server sync rollback
- expo/lib/video-feed.ts: Video feed client — fetchVideoFeed(limit, offset), FeedVideo type with hls_url, poster_url, preview_blur_url, engagement counts, deal enrichment
- expo/lib/video-platform.ts: Video platform API client — channels, viewer ID, follow, save, events, report
- expo/lib/video-upload-pipeline.ts: Staged upload (selected→uploading→uploaded→processing→ready→failed), 500MB max, 10min max, presigned URL flow, poll processing status
- expo/lib/photo-upload.ts: Image upload with compression, retry (3 attempts, exp backoff), concurrent uploads (3), offline queue via AsyncStorage, Supabase storage bucket `deal-photos`
- expo/lib/image-picker-utils.ts: Camera/gallery image picking with permission requests, multi-select, storeImage/storeMultipleImages
- expo/lib/image-storage.ts: StoredImage registry via AsyncStorage, entity-scoped keys, local file directory `ivx_images`
- expo/lib/image-cache-config.ts: Cache policy config — memory-disk default, 100MB memory, 500MB disk, priority-based policy selection
- expo/lib/image-backup.ts: Image backup registry, health scanning (4h interval), recovery from broken URLs
- expo/lib/chat-attachments.ts: Chat file upload helper — image + document picking, Supabase storage upload, deal-photos bucket
- expo/lib/chat-persistence.ts: Conversation persistence — 80 messages max, 24h expiry, normalizes uploading→ready/failed on save
- expo/lib/project-engagement.ts: Project engagement API — media, likes, comments, shares, saves, analytics for project cards
- expo/lib/project-storage.ts: Namespaced AsyncStorage keys — project-scoped and user-scoped isolation, key ownership validation
- expo/lib/deal-photo-health.ts: Deal photo diagnostics — DB/storage/fallback sources, health status (healthy/warning/broken)
- expo/components/CachedImage.tsx: Memory cache with LRU eviction (200 max), prefetch batching (6 at a time)
- expo/components/OptimizedImage.tsx: Thumbnail-first progressive loading, fixed dimensions, retry (3 attempts), placeholder, fade-in, memoized
- expo/components/ImageSlider.tsx: Multi-image carousel with pagination indicators, fullscreen viewer, haptic feedback
- expo/components/ReelErrorBoundary.tsx: Per-reel crash isolation — catches native crashes, retry button with poster, max 3 retries
- expo/components/ProjectCommentsSheet.tsx
